home.subtitle: Let's set up your account. Four steps, about 5 minutes.
home.allDone: Great! All steps done. Your posts now publish automatically.

accountConnected.title: Connect an account
accountConnected.body: Connect Instagram, Threads or a Facebook Page so posts publish automatically.

bioCreated.title: Create your storefront
bioCreated.body: One page with all your products, for your link in bio.

linkAdded.title: Add your first product
linkAdded.body: Paste a Shopee or TikTok Shop link. Title, photo and price fill in automatically.

postScheduled.title: Schedule your first post
postScheduled.body: Write once, publish to all your accounts at the best time.

home.dismissConfirm: Hide the getting-started guide? You can still use every feature.

owner.label: Owner
owner.summary: Full access, including social accounts, subscription and payments.

editor.label: Editor
editor.summary: Creates and schedules posts, manages product links, storefront and auto reply. Can't change the subscription or social accounts.

landing.heroBody: Schedule posts to Instagram, Threads and Facebook, keep product links in your storefront, and send links automatically when someone comments.
landing.feature1Body: Write your post once and let Socialz.id publish it.
landing.feature2Title: A storefront for your bio link
landing.feature2Body: All your affiliate products on one page, with click statistics.
landing.feature3Body: Someone comments "want"? The product link goes out by DM right away.

error.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong or the page has moved.

profile.title: Profile

profile.photoTooLarge: That photo is too large. Pick another one.

password.title: Change password

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account settings and your data.

legal.deleteTitle: How to delete your Socialz.id account
legal.statusCompleted: Done: data from that social account has been deleted.
legal.deleteIntro: You can ask us to delete your Socialz.id account at any time, in either of these ways:
legal.deleteStep2: Or email {email} from your account email address.
legal.deleteSla: We handle requests within {days} days. After that:
legal.deleteAfter1: Your account data, posts, product links, storefront and auto-reply rules are deleted from our systems.
legal.deleteAfter2: Socialz.id loses access to your Instagram, Threads and Facebook accounts.
legal.deleteAfter3: Backup copies are deleted automatically within {days} days.
legal.deleteAfter4: Payment records are kept for {years} years, as tax law requires.
legal.deleteMeta: If you remove Socialz.id from your Instagram or Facebook settings, we receive that request automatically and delete the data from that social account.

accounts.title: Social accounts
accounts.subtitle: Connect accounts so your posts publish automatically.
accounts.empty: No accounts connected yet. Start with Instagram: it is the most used for affiliate sales.

hint.instagram: Business or Creator account. Posts, Reels, Stories and Auto reply.
hint.threads: Text, photo and video posts. Links are clickable.
hint.facebook: Facebook Pages you manage. Links are clickable.

accounts.help: Your Instagram account must be Business or Creator.
accounts.disconnectBody: Published posts stay. Scheduled posts to this account go back to draft.
accounts.verifyFirst: Verify your email first to connect social accounts.
accounts.pickSubtitle: You manage several Pages. Pick the ones to use in Socialz.id.
